ns2:course.label: Soc-Cultur Inquiry Music Learn
ns2:course.description: Consideration of the implications of developmental and socio-contextual inquiry for enhancing music education practice, with an examination of the implications of contemporary theory for the development of more effective teaching and learning processes. Prerequisite: Graduate standing in music or music education, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Graduate standing in music or music education, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Music Education major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
